examples.label: R ≈ S
examples.text: Typical scenes: the same episodes, the same frozen agent, and the reconstruction is a drop-in for the scan — success and SPL within a point, every episode placeable, paths and shortest paths coincide.

examples.label: R > S — the scan's holes are filled
examples.text: Where the laser scan has holes in its floor (under furniture, at windows and mirrors, along walls the scanner never saw), the reconstruction closes them: phantom free space on R is almost entirely scan-hole-filled, shortest paths get shorter (path ratio < 1) and the agent succeeds on R where it was boxed in on S.

examples.label: R < S — floor missing or split on R
examples.text: Where the reconstruction lacks floor — regions the 32 frames never covered or the model left unreconstructed — episodes cannot be placed on R (start or goal more than 0.25 m from any navigable point, or disconnected) and count as failures; the R column shows the S start as a red cross and the video's R side stays static.
